source: https://trackdesk.com/icons/trackdesk-wordmark.svg (symbols wordmark-0/1/2), drawn by the homepage header's <svg viewBox="0 0 7616.47 1312.97"><use href=...#wordmark-0 fill="#23ab66"><use ...#wordmark-1 fill="#fff"><use ...#wordmark-2 fill="currentColor">
edits: kept the green squircle and white bars (elements 0,1); removed the 'Trackdesk' wordmark (element 2)
cropped the viewBox to the squircle (no padding: the squircle is the mark)
notes: DECISION: the header logo is an inline <svg> of <use> references into the sprite trackdesk-wordmark.svg, whose symbols carry no fill. downloads/trackdesk/src2/trackdesk-logo-assembled.svg was made by a script that copied each symbol's path d verbatim from the sprite (saved beside it) with the fill each <use> gives it in the header; no path data was written by hand. The header's green is #23ab66; the apple-touch icon and mask-icon colour are #00b873 (shipped the logo's). The site's own dark logo makes the squircle white with dark bars; not needed, since the green squircle reads on both themes. The mask icon (safari-pinned-tab.svg) is a potrace and the media kit offers PNGs only.
license: Trackdesk brand mark, used nominatively to identify the connected service; trademark rights remain with Trackdesk.
